name: hubs
title: hub.hubs
lead: Every hub that is online, this one included. `id` is what `player:connect` takes.
signature: hub.hubs() → { {id: string, name: string, players: number ?, region: string ?} }
returns: { {id: string , name: string , players: number ?, region: string ?} }

usedIn.quote: for _, h in hub.hubs() do print(h.name, h.players) end
- `hub.hubs()` returns a list of `{id, name, players, region}`, one per hub that is online, this one included. `player:connect(id)` sends a player to that hub.
